release_notes: Ingest 2026-09-08 (Wisenet Q gap fill). No official DataSheet PDF is published in Hanwha's PIM for this model and the product page's full specification table is JS-rendered (not machine-readable); record built from the official product-details overview plus the shared installation manual. Verified: 4MP (2688x1520), built-in 6mm fixed lens, max 20fps@4M / 30fps@under2M, H.265/H.264/MJPEG with WiseStream II, microSD up to 128GB, PoE / 12V DC, IR (R suffix). IR distance, minimum illumination, angle of view, sensor size, operating temperature, dimensions and weight were not machine-readable from official sources and are intentionally omitted (not fabricated).

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Hanwha' (or 'Samsung' on older Blue Iris versions).
